notes: Curated eval focused on period-level forecast reliability rather than single-deal coaching. Output checks require deal risk and data-quality risk to stay separate.

should_trigger.prompt: Prepare a Q2 forecast risk brief for our enterprise segment. Highlight unstable commits, concentration risk by rep and stage, likely slippage patterns, and the interventions sales leadership should make this week.

I have a CRM export with amount, close date, stage, forecast category, last stage change date, and next-step quality. Turn it into a concise leadership-ready forecast risk summary with confidence bands and caveats.
Assess forecast reliability for the APAC team and separate structural risk drivers from deal-specific noise. I need a brief for the weekly leadership review.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Inspect this one strategic deal and tell me whether the rep has enough stakeholder coverage to advance.
Rewrite our stage definitions and exit criteria so managers can inspect them more consistently.
Coach this pricing call and identify the rep behaviors that need improvement.

output_structure_checks.name: forecast-risk-brief-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States forecast scope, as-of date, and a confidence band defined as evidence quality rather than deal health.

output_structure_checks.name: forecast-risk-brief-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Reports low, moderate, and high-risk counts and value, with indeterminate exposure held outside those tiers and no homemade point score.

output_structure_checks.name: forecast-risk-brief-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps deal risk separate from data-quality risk and does not treat evidence confidence as close likelihood.

output_structure_checks.name: forecast-risk-brief-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Includes an intervention plan with owner, confirmed or proposed date state, and verification checkpoint.

output_structure_checks.name: forecast-risk-brief-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Separates decisions to make now from items to monitor later.

task_scenarios.prompt: Review opportunities.csv and context.md for the 24 July enterprise forecast meeting. Summarize forecast coverage, classify each deal by risk, identify concentration and likely slippage, and propose the smallest useful intervention plan with owners and review points. Label any generated date as proposed. Show conflicts and missing evidence rather than choosing the most optimistic source.

assertions.name: forecast-risk-reconciliation
assertions.description: Reconciles forecast totals and presents deal-level risk, evidence, confidence, and interventions with owner, date state, and verification point.

assertions.name: forecast-risk-conflicts
assertions.description: Keeps seller-entered fields as the base record while making conflicting manager or call evidence visible.

assertions.name: forecast-risk-no-optimistic-fill
assertions.description: Does not fill blank evidence, silently select the optimistic source, present a generated date as an existing commitment, or imply CRM changes were approved.

assertions.name: forecast-risk-no-uncalibrated-score
assertions.description: Does not invent equal signal weights, generic stage-aging cutoffs, or fixed score bands to classify exposure when no approved organization-specific model was supplied.
